Introduction
This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
This generator cooled by hydrogen gas using cooling 
water of closed cooling system.
The first
draft initiated by eng. Sadie Yahyia, reviewed, tested by eng. Ibrahem Mohamed 
Abdel Rahman, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Adel Abdel Qader El Nagar Abu Saree, 
accepted by general director eng. Hassan El Rafai Hessain and approved by eng. 
Fawzy Sobhy Ismail head 
 sector of Abu Sultan PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & inspection and 
 quality control general director, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained, qualified or directly supervised by 
 some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, helmet ...etc
The unit must be shut down
Disconnect the main breakers of the generator
Ground the disconnect switch
Disconnect the field breaker.

Ground the disconnect switch
Disconnect the field breaker.
Tools and Equipment
Safety and healthy equipment as safety "helmet, belt, shoes" 
 ...etc
Tool set, Blower, Voltmeter.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
Work to be Carried Out
Operating Maintenance
Clean and 
 replace the brush rigging and collector rings
Clean air filters.
Inspect vertical 
 cooler.
Check the shaft 
 grounding brush.
Shut Down Maintenance
Inspect and clean armature core.
Inspect and test armature winding.
Rotor
Clean the outside surfaces and retaining rings.
Apply a coot of brassolene to prevent 
 rusting.
Insulating Testing
Carry out the the electrical testing to determine 
 the weakness points.
Cleaning
Clean the windings using suitable cleaning 
 fluid.
Other Procedures
Inspect the cooler section.
Check the collector rings.
Interchange the polarity of the collector rings.
Check the protection devices by protection group.
Measure RTD resistance and check the wiring.
